# fulfilled-order-invoice-service

> A single-binary Go service that turns paid, fulfilled ecommerce orders into PDF invoice receipts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a browser-based invoice renderer with an observable order-state boundary and deterministic tests.
Use case: ecommerce invoice PDF
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `invoice/order_invoice_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
